name: typecheck-gate
description: Type-checks the project at the end of every editing turn so errors never slip by.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: notify: toast, status line and a note Claude reads next turn. autofix: start a turn asking Claude to fix the errors.

maxAutofixRounds.title: Autofix rounds
maxAutofixRounds.description: In autofix mode, how many fix turns in a row typecheck-gate may start before it hands over to you.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one checker run may take before it is stopped.
